historicalBaselines.notes: Face values and purchase dates confirmed from owner's Ticketmaster order emails. All early bird purchases made ~June of the prior year (12 months out). Ticketmaster fee model changed: 2023–2024 had explicit per-ticket service charges; 2025–2026 fees appear bundled into face value (no separate charge shown). For like-for-like comparison, use orderTotal / ticket qty as the all-in per-ticket cost.

2023.notes: 2 adult + 1 child. Bought Nov 2022 (~7 months out). Service charges explicit on top. All-in per adult = (£215 face + £15 service) = £230, but order total includes child + programme, so blended. Per-adult all-in = (487.50 - 8.25 - 16.00) / 2 = £231.63 approx.

2024.notes: 1 adult + 1 teen + 1 child. Bought Jun 2023 (~12 months out). Service charges explicit: £19 adult, £18.50 teen. All-in adult = £190 + £19 = £209. All-in teen = £185 + £18.50 = £203.50. Ticketmaster fee model still explicit at this point.

2025.notes: 1 adult + 1 teen + 1 student. Bought Jun 2024 (~12 months out). Fees included in price — no separate service charge shown.

2026.notes: 3 × 'Sky presents the Isle of Wight Weekend Adult Ticket' — all show as Adult GA. Group of 2 adults + teen (teen on adult ticket or same-price tier). Bought Jun 2025 (~12 months out). Sky-sponsored early bird at £231.35 vs standard £368.

twicketsResale.feeNotes: Twickets buyer fee structure: seller listed at £223; offer of £210 accepted by seller. Twickets buyer fee £33.45 (≈15.9% on accepted price) added at checkout. Confirmed all-in total: £243.45.

comparisons.note: Twickets resale (59 days out, offers required) was £12.10 more expensive all-in than the early bird purchased 12 months prior at £231.35. Early bird provided certainty and lower total cost.

twicketsResale.notes: Twickets resale ticket. Listing £223, offer £210 accepted. Twickets buyer fee £33.45 added at checkout (confirmed all-in: £243.45). Despite offer negotiation, ended up £12.10 more than early bird (£231.35). Purchased 59 days before festival.
